blocks.orig: A bush dinner right on the plains of Serengeti National Park is the ultimate romantic dining experience! During a bush dinner, a delicious meal is served on the savannah plains under a sky glittering with stars. Enjoy the crackling of a campfire while listening to the animals scurrying in the dark around you. Usually, tables are set up just outside the camp, but still close enough to be safe.
blocks.html: For the ultimate romantic meal, have a bush dinner out on the plains of Serengeti National Park! A tasty dinner is served to you on the savannah beneath a sky full of sparkling stars. Listen to the crackle of the campfire and to the animals moving about in the darkness around you. The tables are normally set just outside the camp, yet near enough to be safe.
